recommended_action: Enforce role check on the settings endpoint and audit changes

ticket_text: Upload fails for larger files. Files above 25 MB fail while small uploads succeed. This started today and is affecting one workspace. Product: Beacon Desk; version: 4.9.0; channel: API.
root_cause: Gateway request body limit is lower than the documented limit
recommended_action: Align gateway limit with service limit and retry the upload

ticket_text: Email alerts are not delivered. Alert events appear in the app but no email arrives. The issue is intermittent and affects multiple users. Product: Support Hub; version: 4.8.1; channel: API.
root_cause: Mail provider rejected messages due to a sender policy mismatch
recommended_action: Correct sender domain alignment and replay failed messages
